identity.title: Andante and Finale from Rhapsody in Blue

findings: Exact edition identified: Walter Beeler arrangement, Warner Bros./Alfred 00-TS0008, ISBN 9780769275468, for B-flat, E-flat, or C bass-clef instrument with piano.

June Emerson's inspected page dates the issue 1946 and explicitly includes B-flat, E-flat, and C bass-clef parts. Soprano saxophone use follows the B-flat option; the printed listing explicitly names tenor and alto/baritone saxophones rather than a dedicated soprano edition.
Alfred's publisher catalog corroborates arranger and stock number. Stanton's lists the print edition permanently out of print, while June Emerson lists it for sale; availability is retailer-specific.
The three-page Musicnotes instrumental parts are separate digital manifestations. Do not attach full Rhapsody performances as exact recordings of this excerpt arrangement.
